name: Goldsmith
overview: The Scriptures mention goldsmiths as skilled craftsmen involved in the rebuilding and fortification of Jerusalem, highlighting their important role in the community's restoration efforts. Nehemiah 3 records goldsmiths and their descendants actively repairing sections of the city walls, working alongside merchants and other artisans. These verses illustrate the goldsmiths' dedication to the physical and spiritual renewal of God's people, emphasizing the value of faithful labor in service to the Lord's purposes.
